items.snippet: Jan 13, 2026 · json . loads () is a function from Python ’s built-in json module that converts a JSON -formatted string into a corresponding Python object. It is mainly used when JSON data is received as text (for example, from APIs, files, or web responses) and needs to be processed in Python .
